name: PM-AJAY (Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Comprehensive grant assistance for skill development, micro-enterprise creation, and infrastructure for eligible beneficiaries.
benefits: Up to ₹50,000 capital subsidy per beneficiary for micro-enterprise setup + 100% free NSQF skill training.
eligibility: SC / Rural Beneficiaries with annual household income below ₹3.0 Lakh.

name: PMKVY 4.0 (Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
description: Free industry-aligned skill training under NSQF framework with digital badge certification and direct placement assistance.
benefits: Free training + ₹1,500 assessment stipend + official NCVET certificate + job placement assistance.
eligibility: Youth aged 15-45 with basic education seeking formal skill certification.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Collateral-free micro loans for non-farm micro and small enterprises to launch or expand self-employment business.
benefits: Shishu Loan up to ₹50,000 collateral-free at low interest rate for initial equipment and machinery.
eligibility: Self-employed individuals, artisans, tailors, and micro-entrepreneurs.

name: DAY-NRLM / TNSRLM (Tamil Nadu State Livelihood Mission)
description: Financial assistance, revolving fund grants, and market linkages for rural women and community self-help groups.
benefits: Revolving fund of ₹15,000 + Community Investment Fund up to ₹1.10 Lakh per SHG.
eligibility: Rural women self-help groups and individual women artisans.
